domain: Domain X is finite supplied (Word sequence W, raw cue text T) under fixed lexicons. Situation selection yields disjoint negative spans; polar sequence P follows token order, skipping ADP/SCONJ lexical sentiment and span interiors, flipping recognized lexical polarity under negation except cannot-wait. Let I and E be existence flags for the first implicit and explicit eligible pairs, C the distinct cue-kind list, and s=3I+2E+|C|. Return None iff neither pair exists or s<THRESHOLD; otherwise return s, features [implicit if I,explicit if E] followed by C, implicit pair if I else explicit pair, counts of P signs, adjacent sign flips, maximum sign-run length and positive-minus-negative. Invalid parent links supply no ancestry or ended-parent evidence; linear explicit precedence remains usable.
state: Candidate implies I or E, score=3I+2E+cue-kind count and score>=2. Positive+negative=|P|, polarity=positive-negative, flips count adjacent sign changes, longest_run is zero for empty P. Cue kinds occur once in fixed order. No candidate from cues alone. No out-of-range dependency parent is indexed by ancestry/situation checks; a cycle terminates at the bounded walk limit. Pair choice and feature flags must agree.
